subject.title: fix(line): run post-ack webhook processing on its own admitted work root

question: Should runDetachedWebhookWork become a public Plugin SDK contract for ack-first webhook plugins, or remain an internal LINE-owned admission seam?
rationale: Both shapes can repair LINE, but public exposure permanently commits the SDK to gateway admission and restart-drain semantics; repository policy requires an owner decision rather than inferring that contract from the implementation.

options.title: Approve the public SDK helper
options.body: Keep the generic helper public and require focused Plugin SDK documentation and contract coverage before merge.

options.title: Keep the seam LINE-owned
options.body: Move the helper behind a narrow LINE or bundled-runtime boundary so external plugins do not acquire a gateway-admission API contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the public SDK helper
recommendation.body: Keep the generic helper public and require focused Plugin SDK documentation and contract coverage before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects steipete to the admission behavior, making them the strongest available owner for deciding whether that mechanism belongs in the public SDK.
